title: CubeOS API — Go backend, Orchestrator, FlowEngine, REST surface

parent_project.note: This is a component repo of the CubeOS project. The project-level constitution + 9 immutable principles + ADRs live in docs/. This component-level constitution adds api-specific rules without contradicting any project-level Article.

release_workflow: push-to-main-deploys-automatically (CI auto-deploys to all registered Pi devices)

parallel_dev_exception.workflow: merge/<feature_id> short-lived branch + 1 MR per feature + auto-delete branch on merge
parallel_dev_exception.rationale: Per CubeOS project-level ADR-0008. Default push-to-main applies for human work; this override scopes parallel-dev runs to MR-gated merges.

security_posture: edge-deployed (single-tenant on Pi); JWT auth on every route except /health and /api/v1/auth/login; X-HAL-Key for HAL calls
sqlite_driver: modernc.org/sqlite (pure-Go per Article XI of CubeOS constitution)
